# twenty_workspace

Read the authenticated workspace. Takes no arguments and requires no settings permissions. It cannot select another workspace or change settings.

## Example usage

```terraform
data "twenty_workspace" "current" {}

output "workspace_id" {
  value = data.twenty_workspace.current.id
}

output "default_role_id" {
  value = data.twenty_workspace.current.default_role_id
}
```

Member count excludes pending invitations and is informational. Returned URLs may differ from the provider endpoint; they are not followed. No member list or credentials are exported.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `activation_status` (String) Workspace activation status returned by Twenty, such as ACTIVE. The provider authenticates only active workspaces.
- `created_at` (String) Workspace creation timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `custom_domain` (String) Workspace custom domain, or null when none is configured.
- `custom_url` (String) Absolute workspace custom-domain URL, or null when the server has none.
- `default_role_id` (String) UUID of the workspace's default role, or null when no default role is set. This is not the authenticated member's role.
- `display_name` (String) Workspace display name, or null when the server has none.
- `id` (String) Stable UUID of the authenticated workspace.
- `subdomain` (String) Workspace subdomain returned by Twenty.
- `subdomain_url` (String) Absolute workspace subdomain URL returned by Twenty. This can differ from the configured provider endpoint.
- `updated_at` (String) Workspace last-update timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `workspace_members_count` (Number) Workspace user count returned by Twenty, excluding pending invitations. Null means the server returned no count, not zero.
